description: Read a Whiteboard (an Artifact made with spec bisque-canvas/v1) as structure: its frames, every shape with its text and the frame it sits in, what each arrow connects, and an outline with frames as headings, shapes as bullets and arrows as A → B. Pass region to read one area. Use it before changing a board, to answer a comment about it, or to turn the board into a document or a presentation.

artifact_id.description: The Artifact id (art_…): the last part of its link, as in bisque.cloud/documents/art_…, /pages/art_… or /artifacts/art_….

region.description: Board coordinates of an area, as a comment pinned to a region carries them; only what overlaps it is returned.

name: read_board
title: Read a Whiteboard
